verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only mentions fine-grained reactivity via Angular Signals for state updates. Nothing in it documents a resource primitive for treating server-loaded data as reactive state, or suspense-style loading UI primitives. Signals are a related but different reactive feature, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can treat server-loaded data as reactive state and build a responsive loading UI for it using resource and suspense primitives
